metadata.description: Governance as a by-product of doing the work: a harness-agnostic set of assistant configurations for academic data science. 6 workflow-plane planner skills (project, govern, curate, analyze, process, disseminate) delegate to capability-plane doers (datalad, nipoppy, bids, containers, archive, annotate) and their CLI toolboxes, so every computation and every administrative change runs through one DataLad provenance chain and every research object is Self-contained, Tracked, Actionable, Modular, Portable, Ephemeral and Distributable (see docs/stamped.md). The default export is a living compendium — provenanced dataset, re-executable article, agent-callable method bundle, self-hostable deployment — cross-linked by DOI. Status: the workflow plane is built, the capability plane is uneven, and the evaluation protocol is unrun (see docs/motivation.md).

plugins.name: project
plugins.description: Project lifecycle planner: scaffold a new YODA/BIDS DataLad study and orient a researcher (coordinator agent) on where a project stands.

plugins.name: govern
plugins.description: Governance planner (Manage & Comply lane): preregister freezes a comparison's spec before execution and registers it as a confirmatory obligation; obligations tracks and resolves the project's outstanding commitments in the ledger.

plugins.name: analyze
plugins.description: Analysis planner: propose comparisons on their own branch, run them with full (optionally containerized) provenance, and checkpoint clean snapshots.

plugins.name: datalad
plugins.description: DataLad doer: the tool subagent that executes all DataLad / git-annex operations with provenance on behalf of the planner skills.

plugins.name: curate
plugins.description: Curation planner: raw-to-bids converts raw acquisitions to a BIDS layout via nipoppy with DataLad provenance; annotate enriches a dataset's metadata (dataset_description.json, participants.json data dictionary, BIDS sidecars, controlled-term mappings). Advances STAMPED Self-containment + Actionability.

plugins.name: process
plugins.description: Processing planner: run nipoppy pipelines (fMRIPrep, MRIQC, ...) on BIDS data with full DataLad provenance, then record completion. Orchestrates the nipoppy and datalad doers.

plugins.name: disseminate
plugins.description: Dissemination planner: turn provenanced work into published, linked products. publish pushes committed state to a sibling and verifies an independent clone can retrieve the outputs; dataset-release cuts a citable versioned release with a DOI via the archive doer; link-outputs cross-links products; draft-manuscript and reporting-checklist produce the paper; executable-article (NeuroLibre), agent-bundle (Paper2Agent) and liab-deploy (Lab-in-a-Box) produce the living compendium. Advances STAMPED Distributability.

plugins.name: nipoppy
plugins.description: Nipoppy doer: the tool subagent that constructs/validates nipoppy pipeline commands and hands dataset-mutating steps to the datalad doer for provenanced execution.

plugins.name: containers
plugins.description: Containers doer: builds an Apptainer/Singularity .sif from a project's recipe (with the docker-archive workaround) so analyses have a pinned, rebuildable environment; registration/running stay with the datalad doer.

plugins.name: bids
plugins.description: BIDS doer: read-only validation of a dataset against the Brain Imaging Data Structure (bids-validator + structural checks); reports conformance, never modifies the dataset.

plugins.name: archive
plugins.description: Archive doer: deposits a released version to an external archive (OSF/Zenodo/DataCite) and mints a persistent DOI; reports 'unminted' rather than fabricating one when credentials are absent.

plugins.name: annotate
plugins.description: Annotate doer: builds and validates a dataset's machine-readable metadata — participants.json data dictionaries and controlled-term coverage against Neurobagel/SNOMED, ReproSchema and NIDM; reports a term it could not look up as 'unannotated' rather than recalling one, and an uninstalled backend as unavailable rather than as zero matches.

plugins.name: datalad-cli
plugins.description: DataLad skill toolbox: 19 focused skills wrapping individual datalad subcommands (create, run, save, container-run, siblings, push, ...).

plugins.name: nipoppy-cli
plugins.description: Nipoppy skill toolbox: dataset curation, BIDS conversion, pipeline running/tracking, and IDP extraction for neuroimaging studies.

plugins.name: archive-cli
plugins.description: Archive skill toolbox: one skill per backend (OSF, Zenodo, DataCite) for deposit, DOI minting and related identifiers, plus the offline readiness check the archive doer runs before any deposit.

plugins.name: annotate-cli
plugins.description: Annotate skill toolbox: one skill per annotation tool (bagel-cli for Neurobagel, pynidm for NIDM, reproschema for instrument schemas, snomed-lookup for clinical codes), plus the offline per-backend check the annotate doer runs first. Most of them validate terms rather than find them, and each says so.
